rounds.notes:
[Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) 
Always beam 2 targets, make sure to not miss cooldowns (Firestrikes, Rockets, Torpedoes).
Basic Mercy rules apply for the whole build: Do not lose sight of teammates, know everyones health at all times, play defensively. 
#
#

With this power you can heal through walls and your range on your secondary is ***infinite*** for the duration. Catch your reaper port before he leaves so you can boost or heal no matter how far away he is. Catch your lucio flying into the enemy team to support him no matter how fast or how far he's going, all while supporting your primary with whatever they need. After the 3 seconds, maybe fly to them, tap them, slingshot back to safety and heal your tank and the dps both.

Keep in mind you will expose the hiding place of an ally if you shoot a random beam across the map. Make sure to not help the enemy team figure out where they went.

Also, too much back and forth makes low-elo dps think you are pocketing them, so they will run into their deaths, wondering why you didn't help. One of the reasons  [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7) is so powerful is because of how many mistakes of your team you can correct. If your team is flawless,  [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7) can often be skipped.


DURING VALK  [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb)  is *disabled*, keep this in mind before you think the dps flanking over a wall will have the beam. It will break like in normal overwatch.

[Blessed Boosters](item_957fd380-b7b4-40d4-8333-bb8c535ca931) 
This is not just a survivability perk, this enables you to go for crazy dives and blinking out instantly with slingshots. Take this everytime and you will start to understand there is nowhere you can't go, all you need is a GA target and 90% of your positioning-needs are covered. Enemy DPS can't get you because the travel-speed after slingshot is now so fast,  you basically have invincibility frames for every GA.

Now, if you dont play mercy usually, all it takes is 1 mis-managed GA to completely trash your positioning, still, I highly recommend getting feel for it.


 [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) 
same value like  [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) for 2'000 less. Pick this everytime you have 4000 and a free slot.

 [Mid-Air Mobilizer](item_760c1441-8cfa-426c-885d-8d0dec32e145) again, same value like  [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) for 2'000 less, as long as you are airborne, which you should be most of the time, especially with  [Blessed Boosters](item_957fd380-b7b4-40d4-8333-bb8c535ca931) 

 [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) good value overall, solid pick for leftover money

[Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) 
This removes the need for building raw healing powerand instead requires you to time your GA when the targets health is 50% or less.
Beginning this round, if you see a window where the health will be half or under, invest maybe 1 second before using the planned GA so you can proc the healing buff and continue the fight. Patience is the key with this power. Invest 1 second and just fly in idle, calculate if the 1 second is worth. In a more advanced ow-mind, let the tank fall from 60% to 50% and damage boost instead, then GA and heal, and get more net-value overall.
This has *no cooldown*. Meaning you can apply the buff, heal for 1 second, USE VALK to reset GA and GA again to apply the buff for a second time and get another round of strong healing.

It's time now to build depending on what your team needs.
Round 1 and 2 have given you an idea of what your weak points are.

Don't sell [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e), if you cant afford a pink one, just stack power with [Mid-Air Mobilizer](item_760c1441-8cfa-426c-885d-8d0dec32e145) and/or  [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054). DO NOT get  [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a), instead get the above and buy the green stuff from round 1

Checklist time:

"I can reach my teammates just fine, I dont have down-time, more heal should be all I need"
[Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48)  is the safest choice. Raw power and a boost to survivability and mobility. You can also shoot many shots in a short time before continuing beam. This and  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) together with timing  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) makes your heal really strong. Remember the  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) into Valkyrie into another  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) 


"I can't always reach my teammates and have to position myself dangerously" (aggressive reaper, lucio, reinhardt charge-happy, general unawareness of the team to group, team is split across the map)
 [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7)  is the play. 10% power for 10'000 is not good, obviously. But not reaching your teammates and constantly being forced to make bad positioning choices is way worse. With this you can jump vertically and reach your teammates just with that, all while staying near cover. This also makes  [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb)  be on steroids, chaining your 2 damage-VIPs together now becomes easy, you dont have to plan or think about it anymore. Using  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) will compensate for the low 10% gain. And surely the team is split because there is a very good reason and you can focus on tank without worrying about trolls right? Right.


"My dps are him. I can reach my teammates. I was not the main-heal in Round 2, I'm mainly pocketing the good dps"
 [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca) This usually means the enemy team is now gonna focus you, because pocketing good dps makes you more of a target, bad dps makes them ignore you more, especially because [Blessed Boosters](item_957fd380-b7b4-40d4-8333-bb8c535ca931) makes it pain to chase you.  The Armor from [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca) + your insane travel speed should make you unkillable now, the Armor might throw enemies off, first trying to get you, realizing its hopeless and going for dps instead, at which point  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) should be enough to compensate for your investment. And since you are not the main healer,  [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) boosting damage of your team is the play. Don't forget to have 2 beams on allies, even when you are flanking with 1 dps, try to "send" a beam every now and then.

Checklist again.

"I can reach my team. I don't die. My team probably won't survive if I don't get more healing."
 [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b)  or  [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) Raw power-sticks, stack the blue items from Round 3 if you are poor. I prefer  [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b) because it makes the 3-5 seconds of pistoling every round more deadly. Pick  [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) if you dont really have pistol-windows this game.


"I can't reach my team (this also means if the enemy is diving a lot, or you get flanked/chased by dps, meaning you have to use  [Blessed Boosters](item_957fd380-b7b4-40d4-8333-bb8c535ca931) to create an un-natural distance between you and your allies, creating downtime and being useless)"
 [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7) 
This is 50% of all games at this point, do not underestimate the power of this perk. 2 seconds of not healing because youre not in range can lose you the entire round. Also, healing your diving team for 2 more seconds before you have to decide where to GA makes your next GA a safe move most of the time, you can get behind cover everytime during the whole fight, all you have to do is peak out, use the range on whoever you want, jump up vertically along the wall if you want some accuracy. There is no down-time with this perk, your beam is always where it needs to be. I get this most of the games now.

"My team needs my healing but it feels enough and doesn't need to be higher."  [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca) This is where you need to be careful, if you get this perk this early it means your heal will be as-high as last round, ask yourself if that's fine. If there is doubt, it's better to stay safe going  [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7), which will give you the exact edge and utility you need, or just raw power items mentioned above. About
 [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca): Even if you mainly heal your tank, chaining to a dps here and there is enough to get value out of this. More charge means faster ult for your tank as well. 50 Armor and  [Blessed Boosters](item_957fd380-b7b4-40d4-8333-bb8c535ca931) will make the enemy rage-quit before trying to get you, be ready to time  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4)  since they will try to burst your team down instead.
Get  [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca)  every game eventually when you reach that sweet spot of "not needing more healing"

[Protective Beam](item_3f1ef995-8ecc-45fb-8b57-26fdccc21feb) goes well with  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4), your ally drops health slower from the top and you have more time reacting to burst-combos.  The damage from enemy dps should be high enough to get your dps down to half extremely quickly, at which point you switch to heal, GA to get  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) boost, go back up and repeat. Also a great solution if your team dies instantly everytime, now you actually have a window where healing can happen.


Sell  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) and  [Mid-Air Mobilizer](item_760c1441-8cfa-426c-885d-8d0dec32e145)

Try to get to 45% power and still carry the 2 Perks [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7)  and  [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca).
If you are the main heal consider skipping/selling [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca), and get more power instead.

Get [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48) if you don't have it yet, it has the best value overall.

In extreme loss-situations, keep reading:



"My team cant kill anything"
MMR issue probably.
It's time to go battle-mercy, you can be the equalizer when it comes to damage.  Get [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb) with  [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b)  and  [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48), keep  [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca) for the armor and getting Valk faster. Consider selling  [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7) since your team is probably too scared and hugging allies and/or trolling, reaching them from far away will make no difference anymore, since they will die anyways if they are out of position. If you still believe or are too lazy for battle-mercy, get [Protective Beam](item_3f1ef995-8ecc-45fb-8b57-26fdccc21feb) and follow standard.


"The enemy team focuses me, I got to low health last round constantly, forcing me to cancel everything and save myself (or I died a lot), they are mercy-haters and/or they realize you are the true carry so everyone goes for you. My team would win if I just stay alive."
 [Serenity](item_c6e1c072-ff50-467e-b59f-9506baea10c1) will fix it usually, also a good choice if your other support cant save you quickly and reliably. Get  [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca) for that 50 Armor and giving your dps a bit more help with boost. If you are the main tank for some reason, or the enemy hitscan is him, also get  [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) and  [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09). If enemy AP power kills you, not weapon damage, get  [Vishkar Condensor](item_086a91da-b65d-4047-8fc7-28a992078b1d) and  [Reinforced Titanium](item_8ebaa7db-aedf-48ed-adc1-318cb46a3214)

It's important to remember that most damage output now is so high, wether you have 15% more healing or not will not make a difference usually. 

More  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) Buff procs will make a difference.
I prefer  [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) over  [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124), because the CDR makes GA faster, meaning more [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) and faster split-second decisions.


Something I never really tried but worth noting here,  [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) might be the play because GA has more value than healing output now.


If you are battle mercy get [The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce)  and don't get  [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7)

You've done it, you have survived this far and are pretty much a scared observer now. Which is why, after 6 rounds of peace and quiet, it's time to surprise your enemies with a full blown aerial assault.

 [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb) When you ult in Round 7, pull out your pistol and use the element of surprise, to get into someones face and burst them down. Remember to still use  [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4)  on allies below 50%. You have enough weapon power to make that difference with a few shots. Even without  [Battle Medic](item_ccd0edff-4d57-4ac2-83a7-bab6ff0ffb2f), this is still worth it, because you heal your entire team instead of just 2. Just remember to not fly there with your staff, not doing anything. Ult = Pistol!
It's worth going Battle-Mercy at Round 5 sometimes just to practice Round 7-Situations, or if you just like Battle-Mercy.



Get  [Battle Medic](item_ccd0edff-4d57-4ac2-83a7-bab6ff0ffb2f) if you already picked  [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb). This is why you have to make the choice at Round 5. The 2 perks together transform mercy into a dps hero and you can compensate your teams low damage
